observations: The complete 55-line formula installs vip but contains no test block and no disable! declaration. No source or build evidence supports additional installation, dependency, or platform findings.

findings.reason: The complete formula has no test block to exercise the installed pipeline editor, so its functional behavior is unverified by brew test.
findings.verification: On an appropriate Homebrew machine, add and run a functional test that pipes known text through the installed vip with a noninteractive editor helper and asserts the edited output; run brew test vip.
